info.description: The Pokémon TCG API provides access to a variety of resources about Pokémon Trading Card Game cards, sets, types, subtypes, and rarities. It allows users to retrieve card details, search for cards, and access up-to-date information without requiring an API key, albeit with lower rate limits.
